import html # Example template (replace with the actual one used in your project) USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

Posted by: {author_name}

{content}
{tags}
""" def create_post_html(author_name: str, post_title: str, content: str, post_tags: list[str]) -> str: """ Construct an XSS‑protected HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_name : str The name of the post's author. post_title : str The headline of the user's post. content : str The primary text content of the user's post. post_tags : list[str] A collection of tags related to the post. Returns ------- str The HTML string with all user‑controlled input properly escaped. """ # Escape all user supplied strings esc_author = html.escape(author_name, quote=True) esc_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) esc_content = html.escape(content, quote=False) # Preserve line breaks etc. # Render each tag inside a and escape it escaped_tags = [ f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in post_tags ] tags_html = ' '.join(escaped_tags) # Format the template with escaped values html_output = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_name=esc_author, title=esc_title, content=esc_content, tags=tags_html ) return html_output
